title: finding(skills): SKILL.md still teaches the dead `cols` layout spelling that protocol.md and mobile.md both forbid
body:
Found while implementing #5372 (the envelope-teaching fix). **Not claimed; observation class, filed unassigned.** Different defect class from #5372's envelope rule, so deliberately not fixed on that PR. Baseline objectui `origin/main` @ `f1c27f037`.

## The fact

`skills/objectui/SKILL.md:81` — the top-level file of the published skill, the one an agent loads before any guide — says:

> Layouts are just components that render children. Treat `Grid`, `Stack`, `Container` as first-class citizens. Layout schemas must support responsive props (e.g. `cols: { sm: 1, md: 2, lg: 4 }`).

Two files in the same published package say that spelling is dead:

- `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md:252` — "**❌ DO NOT** spell it `cols` — no schema, renderer or registry declares that key, so the value is dropped on the floor and the grid renders a flat two columns at *every* breakpoint (objectui#4001)."
- `skills/objectui/guides/mobile.md:100` — "`"props": { "cols": … }` leaves both the columns *and* the card titles unread (objectui#4001)."

`AGENTS.md` §5 Commandment #5 states the same rule for the codebase.

So the entry file prescribes the spelling the rule files retire, and it also uses the `sm` base key where `GridSchema`'s base breakpoint is `xs`. An author who reads only `SKILL.md` — which is the intended entry point — writes `cols` and gets a flat two-column grid at every breakpoint, with nothing thrown and nothing logged. That is the same silent-wrong-render failure shape #5372 exists to stop, arriving through a different key.

## Why it is a separate card

#5372's scope is the `props` / `properties` envelope rule and was held to it. This is the layout key spelling, whose direction was already settled by #4001 — no decision is owed, only the edit. Recording it rather than riding it in keeps that PR's diff reviewable as one claim.

## Suggested shape

One-line in-place replacement in `SKILL.md`, matching the wording already in `rules/protocol.md`: `columns` — a number, or a breakpoint object keyed `xs` / `sm` / `md` / `lg` / `xl`, with `xs` as the base. Net addition zero. Worth checking whether any `evals/*.json` grades the `cols` spelling the same way `evals/schema-expressions.json` was found to grade the retired `props.*` envelope (fixed on #5372's PR).

## Recheck

```
grep -rn '`cols`\|"cols"\|cols:' skills/
sed -n '81p' skills/objectui/SKILL.md
sed -n '250,256p' skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md
```

## Grading

`finding`, not `pm:queue`. Related: #4001, #5372.
